title: Rotation Unit Value: Later Contract Prices and Aged Shipments
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — the unit value that turns a stock-rotation allowance into units.**

1. Where the latest contract item price line for the rotation item's item number on the customer's active Contract Pricing Agreement, latest by effective date and the only line for that item number with that effective date, is not a removal, takes effect after the ship date of the line's shipment and sets a contract unit price below the invoiced unit price, the allowance is divided by that contract unit price.
2. Where that does not hold and the shipment is dated at least 12 whole months before the request date, the allowance is divided by the invoiced unit price reduced by 15 percent, rounded half up to 4 decimals.
3. In every other case — including where the item number has no price line on the active agreement or the customer has no active agreement — the unit value is not changed by this rule.

The invoiced unit price is the unit price of the line's one shipment. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than the day of the month of the earlier date.

### Conditions of clause 1, all required

| Condition | Read from |
|---|---|
| the price line is the latest for that item number on the active agreement, by effective date | the agreement's contract item price lines |
| it is the only line for that item number with that effective date | the same lines |
| it is not a removal | the kind of price line |
| its effective date is after the ship date (a later day, not the same day) | the line's effective date and the shipment's ship date |
| its contract unit price is below the invoiced unit price | the price line and the shipment |

If any one of them fails, clause 2 is tested next.

### Hypothetical cases (invoiced unit price 20.00)

| Case | Unit value |
|---|---|
| latest line, sole on its date, not a removal, effective after the ship date, contract price 17.50 | 17.50 |
| same, but the line's effective date is the ship date itself; shipment dated 14 whole months before the request | 17.0000 (20.00 reduced by 15 percent) |
| no price line for the item number; shipment dated 11 whole months before the request | not changed by this rule |
| two lines for the item number share the latest effective date; shipment dated 12 whole months before | 17.0000 |
